verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents creating, acknowledging and resolving incidents directly from Slack, with events synced to the dashboard. It can also post a todo list on new incidents and route them to the right responder, and Slack alerts carry acknowledge actions. However, there is no evidence of auto-created incident channels, assigned incident roles, or structured status updates, and Teams appears only as a notification and AI SRE surface, not for declaring incidents. Missing for 10: automatic dedicated incident channel creation, incident role assignment (e.g. commander), chat-driven stakeholder/status updates, incident declaration from Microsoft Teams, independent or hands-on corroboration.
